name: Spark Archive
summary: Open, extract and make archives: zip, tar (gz, bz2, xz, zst), 7z, rar and iso, also in several parts and with passwords.
summary_fr: Ouvrir, extraire et créer des archives : zip, tar (gz, bz2, xz, zst), 7z, rar et iso, aussi en plusieurs parties et avec mot de passe.

write: zip (AES-256, or ZipCrypto that opens on any PC but is weak)

optional.compression.zstd: tar.zst with Python 3.14+ (otherwise the zstd command or libarchive)
optional.7z: password-protected 7z, making 7z and password-protected zip, split zip, and zip AES if libarchive can't decrypt it
optional.unrar: password-protected RAR (RPM Fusion's unrar package; in the SparkOS image)
optional.dolphin: the right-click menu and Show in folder
